decisions.reason: It builds on existing mechanical and production knowledge in garage doors, allowing the firm to assimilate and improve the operator line.
As a direct extension of the industrial door range, the firm can readily interpret results and apply its related glazing and sectional-door knowledge.
Combining existing glazing and insulation capabilities gives high absorptive capacity to refine the product from early results.
Its close relation to established glazed industrial doors and dedicated market presence make early results interpretable and support continued investment.
